'''Derwen''' is an ancient servant of [[Guthix]], who takes great interest in [[Justiciar Zachariah]] and [[Porazdir]], attempting to keep a balance between them.{{CiteNPC|npc=Kolodion|quote=[Derwen] seems to take great interest in the other two creatures. Maybe he is trying to keep a balance between them.}} 

During the [[Mage Arena II]] [[Miniquests|miniquest]], he has to be defeated in order to obtain [[ent's roots|his roots]] for [[Kolodion]]'s spell. In order to summon him, players have to use an [[enchanted symbol]] to locate him, similar to using an [[enchanted key]] or [[strange device]].
[[File:Fighting Derwen.png|thumb|left|270px|A player fighting Derwen.]]
When fighting Derwen, he will cast the [[Claws of Guthix]] spell - unlike the version cast by the Guthix [[Battle mage|battle mages]] in the [[Mage Arena]], this will reduce your [[Defence]] level by 1 + 5%. He can also use a special attack which will release multiple balls of energy in the area around him. These balls of energy will heal Derwen for five [[Hitpoints]] every few seconds. They can be destroyed by the player, having 20 hitpoints each. He can also [[Tele Block]] the player for one minute, and cast freezes preventing the player from moving.

Derwen can only be harmed by the [[Claws of Guthix]] spell. As such, a [[Guthix staff]], a [[staff of balance]], or the [[void knight mace|Void Knight mace]] is required to defeat him. Despite being referred to as an ent, killing Derwen will not count towards an ent Slayer task from Krystillia.
